brief:
Israel continues to hold gynaecologist Dima Amin in detention after she was arrested at her Ramallah home on allegations of social media incitement, Middle East Eye reported. Amin reportedly suffered a heart attack following her arrest, raising concerns about her medical condition during captivity.

The specifics surrounding her detention and the timing of her cardiac episode remain unclear from available reports. Her case has drawn attention to conditions faced by Palestinian detainees held by Israeli authorities, particularly regarding access to adequate medical care. Amin's continued detention underscores broader concerns about the treatment of Palestinians arrested on charges related to online activity.

title: Israel holds abducted Palestinian doctor after heart attack
